format: json-schema (structured outputs): {гриб, состав[{вещество, содержание, влияние}], maxItems 100}
system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"гриб": "...", "состав": [{"вещество": "...", "содержание": "...", "влияние": "..."}]} (mushroom / composition list / compound / amount / effect). In «содержание» give a number with a unit (% of fresh weight, % of dry weight, mg/kg, mg/g, or per fruiting body) — if you do not know, write «неизвестно». In «влияние» give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. No text outside the JSON.
